context: Multi-panel data visualization — tidal harmonic decomposition dashboard with a 14-day composite signal chart, a daily cycle plot, and a ridgeline amplitude distribution, with interactive harmonic toggles and linked hover.
first_impression: A polished dark-theme scientific dashboard with intentional color choices and clear typographic hierarchy that reads as genuinely designed rather than default-generated.
what_works: The four-constituent color palette (blue, amber, green, pink) harmonizes well on the dark background and distinguishes neatly from the bright composite line; typographic hierarchy from title to panel labels to axis ticks to tick marks is well-executed and gives the eye a clear entry point.
what_doesnt: The cycle plot's 14 overlapping daily traces are all rendered in the same low-opacity white, making the panel visually muddy without adding interpretive value beyond the mean line — coloring by day or day-of-cycle would give the overlay purpose. The spring/neap annotation badges sit at the very top edge of the main chart and are clipped or crowded, reducing their readability.
